snippet.title: Shovel Knight Dig tunnels onto Xbox & PS5 on May 15th
snippet.description:
Ready your shovels! 

Shovel Knight Dig is tunneling onto Xbox and PlayStation 5 on May 15, 2025. This ultimate edition includes the complete game and all downloadable content.

The Xbox and PS5 versions will include the base game and all expansions, including the upcoming DLC, Wicked Wishes. This final update adds new bosses, quests, secrets, and game-changing upgrades, making this the definitive version of Shovel Knight Dig!

If you own the Nintendo Switch, Steam, and Apple Arcade versions of the game, all platforms will receive the Wicked Wishes DLC update same day! 

Whether you're a longtime fan or a new adventurer, there's never been a better time to dig in.
